verses.text: "Listen to this, people of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel and come from the family line of Judah. You make promises in the name of the LORD and call on the God of Israel, but not in truth or in righteousness.
You call yourselves citizens of the holy city and claim to depend on the God of Israel, whose name is the LORD of Armies.
I told you long ago what would happen. My mouth announced it, and I made it known. Then suddenly I acted, and it happened.
For I knew how stubborn you are. Your neck is as stiff as iron, and your forehead as hard as bronze.
So I told you these things long ago. Before they happened I announced them to you, so that you could not say, 'My idol did them. My carved image and my metal god commanded them.'
You have heard these things. Now look at them all. Will you not admit it? From now on I will tell you about new things, hidden things you have not known.
They are created now, not long ago. You have not heard about them before today, so you cannot say, 'Yes, I knew about them.'
You have not heard or understood. Your ears have been closed since long ago. For I knew how unfaithful you are. You have been called a rebel since you were born.
For the sake of my name I hold back my anger. For the sake of my praise I hold it back from you, so that I do not cut you off.
Look, I have refined you, but not like silver. I have tested you in the furnace of suffering.
For my own sake, for my own sake, I do this. How can I let my name be disgraced? I will not give my glory to anyone else.
Listen to me, Jacob, Israel whom I have called: I am he. I am the first, and I am the last.
My own hand laid the foundations of the earth, and my right hand spread out the heavens. When I call them, they all stand up together.
Gather together, all of you, and listen! Which of the idols has told about these things? The one the LORD loves will carry out his plan against Babylon. His arm will be against the Babylonians.
I, yes I, have spoken. I have called him. I will bring him, and he will succeed in his mission.
Come near to me and listen to this: From the beginning I have not spoken in secret. When it happens, I am there." And now the Lord GOD has sent me with his Spirit.
This is what the LORD says, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: "I am the LORD your God, who teaches you what is good for you, who leads you in the way you should go.
Oh, if only you had listened to my commands! Then your peace would have flowed like a river, and your righteousness like the waves of the sea.
Your descendants would have been as many as the sand, and your children as many as its grains. Their name would never be cut off or wiped out from before me."
Leave Babylon! Run away from the Babylonians! Announce this with shouts of joy and make it known. Send it out to the ends of the earth. Say, "The LORD has rescued his servant Jacob!"
They were not thirsty when he led them through the deserts. He made water flow for them from the rock. He split the rock, and water gushed out.
"There is no peace for the wicked," says the LORD.
